parties: Tata Steel Limited (acquirer) | TM International Logistics Limited (target)
headline: Tata Steel Acquires Equity Stake in TM International Logistics Limited
sum: Tata Steel has acquired an equity stake in TM International Logistics Limited, signalling expansion into the logistics sector. Details on stake percentage and consideration remain undisclosed in publicly available sources.
implication: Vertical integration or ancillary-service expansion by a steel conglomerate into logistics-partners should review whether this triggers group company compliance, related-party transaction reporting under Listing Rules, or Competition Act thresholds.
detail: Tata Steel Limited filed a corporate action notification with NSE on 20 August 2026 regarding acquisition of equity stake in TM International Logistics Limited. The precise stake percentage, consideration amount, and closure conditions are not confirmed from accessible public sources. The transaction appears to represent strategic diversification or supply-chain integration by the steel major.

framework.note: applicable if stake ≥ 25% or turnover threshold met
review if TM International has overseas operations or FDI

framework.ref: Sebi Listing Regulations 2015 § 16 (disclosure of material events)
Income Tax Act, 1961 § 92F (transfer pricing, if related party)

approvals: Possible CCI notification if acquisition triggers combination test

triggers.note: Acquisition notifiable if combined turnover or asset threshold crossed; CCI review likely if Tata Steel + TM International > ₹1,500 cr turnover or ₹750 cr assets
If TM International is deemed related party (group company, associate, or director-affiliate), requires shareholder approval and audit-committee clearance
